what_it_is: Not machine learning — the simplest possible reference line, so we have something familiar to compare against.
Genuine ML. Learns the trend AND how confident to be — confidence shrinks near known years, grows the further it guesses into the future.
Genuine ML. Learns the trend while deliberately ignoring small year-to-year noise, so a few unusual years do not throw it off.
Genuine ML — but the WRONG tool here on purpose, to prove the point: it cannot guess beyond years it has already seen, so it just freezes.
